common.footnote: Sign-in only with a work email and a second factor. Every sign-in is written to the audit log — together with everything you do afterwards.

login.lead: A separate sign-in system: a player account doesn't work here — not even your own.
login.expired: Time for the authenticator code ran out — you get five minutes. Enter your email and password again.

mfa.lead: Password accepted. Enter the six digits from your authenticator app — you have five minutes.
mfa.recovery_hint: Looks like xxxxx-xxxxx. Each code works once and is used up after sign-in.
mfa.invalid: The code didn't work. {count, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}} left, then access is closed for an hour and we notify the admins.
mfa.locked: The code didn't work — access is closed for an hour, and we've notified the admins. If it wasn't you, contact an owner or admin.

reauth.title: Confirm sign-in
reauth.text: 20 minutes passed without activity, or your network changed. Enter the app code — you'll continue where you left off, nothing you typed is lost.

accept.lead: First sign-in by invitation: the email from the letter, a new password and the code from the letter. Then — second-factor setup.
accept.password_hint: From 10 to 128 characters; common passwords are rejected. A phrase of several words is easier to remember than random characters.
accept.code_hint: The code from the invitation email, like xxxxx-xxxxx: 10 Latin letters and digits; case, dashes and spaces don't matter. The invitation lives for 24 hours.
accept.resent: If the invitation for this email is still active, an email with the same code is on its way — the code from earlier emails works too. No email? Check spam.

setup.lead: Scan the QR code in Google Authenticator, 1Password or any other authenticator app and enter the six digits. Until the second factor is set up, the admin opens only this screen.
setup.qr: QR code for the authenticator app
setup.secret: Can't scan? Enter the secret manually
setup.invalid: The code didn't work. Make sure the time on your phone is set automatically and enter a new code.
setup.codes_text: Each code works once instead of the app code. We show them exactly once — later you can only regenerate them in My access, and the old ones stop working at once.
setup.file_header: Admin recovery codes. Each code works once.
setup.confirmed_title: The second factor is already confirmed
setup.confirmed_text: The authenticator app is connected; only the last step is left. Recovery codes are shown once and won't appear here again — you can issue new ones in My access.
setup.elsewhere: Two-factor setup is being continued in another tab. Finish it there, or start over here: the QR code in that tab will stop working.
setup.replay: A response with a secret isn't stored, so it can't be repeated. Start the setup again — the app will get a new QR code.

connection.refused_title: The server refused access to the admin panel
connection.text: The admin panel got no response from the server. Check your connection and retry.

forbidden.title: No access to this section
forbidden.text: This section needs a permission your role doesn't have. An owner or admin can grant access.
forbidden.block_text: Seeing it needs a permission your role doesn't have. An owner or admin can grant access.

empty.title: Nothing found
empty.text: No records match this search and filter. This is not an error — it is just empty.

no_network.title: No connection
no_network.text: We will show it as soon as it is back.

offline.text: No network. Decisions will not be sent; showing the last loaded data.

desktop_only.notice: Granting and revoking access — desktop only
desktop_only.hint: You can view it here; to change it, open the admin panel on a computer.

rate_limited.title: Too many requests
rate_limited.text: The server slowed requests down to protect data. You can retry in {seconds} s.

pending_approval.title: Sent for approval
pending_approval.text: The action runs once a second staff member with the right approves it. The request lives 24 hours; track it in Approvals.

toast.not_undone: Not undone: the action still stands
toast.stale: Already changed — data refreshed, nothing undone

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.text: What you entered will be lost

field_errors.common: This password is too common — choose another one

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.single_hint: Turn off if keys fire by accident (for example, with a screen reader). {mod}+K always works.

me.subtitle: Second factor, recovery codes and active sessions
me.locked: Access is closed for an hour: five wrong codes or passwords in a row. We have notified the administrators. If it was not you, contact an owner or an admin.
me.reauth_retry: Sign-in confirmed. A second-factor code works only once — enter a new code: the action has not been done yet.

mfa.title: Second factor
mfa.since: Authenticator app connected {date}. The code is asked at sign-in and after 20 minutes of inactivity. A new device can only be set up through a second staff member.
mfa.off: Second factor is not set up
mfa.lost_text: Access is restored by an owner or an admin: one requests an access reset, a second one confirms it. Your password, second factor, recovery codes and sessions are revoked, and a new invitation is sent to your work email. There is no self-service “forgot password” — nobody can take over sign-in through email.

codes.title: Recovery codes
codes.low: Almost no codes left — reissue them while you still have your authenticator app.
codes.text: Each code works once. The codes are shown only when issued — after that only a reissue, and the old ones stop working at once.

regenerate.title: New recovery codes
regenerate.text: The old codes stop working immediately. Confirm with a code from your authenticator app — a recovery code is not accepted here.
regenerate.unknown: No response arrived — the codes may have been reissued. If the counter below shows “10 of 10”, the old codes no longer work: issue new ones again and save them.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.label: Sessions
sessions.revoked: Session ended. That device will need to sign in again.
sessions.revoked_others: {count, plural, =0 {There were no other sessions} one {# session ended} other {# sessions ended}}
sessions.note: A session lives 8 hours and ends when the network changes. After 20 minutes of inactivity the admin asks for the second factor again — inconvenient by design.

password.title: Change password
password.text: Current password, the new one twice and the second factor. Your other sessions will end — this one stays.
password.new_hint: 10 to 128 characters; common passwords are not accepted. A phrase of several words is easier to remember than a jumble of characters.
password.recovery_hint: Looks like xxxxx-xxxxx. The code is used up even if the password is not changed.
password.password_invalid: The current password is wrong. {count, plural, one {# attempt left} other {# attempts left}}, then access closes for an hour and we notify the administrators.
password.mfa_invalid: The code did not match. {count, plural, one {# attempt left} other {# attempts left}}, then access closes for an hour and we notify the administrators.
password.unknown: Result unknown: no response arrived, and the password may have changed. Do not repeat the change with the old password — a wrong password counts towards the lockout; sign in with the new password.

two_hands.title: Two-person rule
two_hands.text: One staff member can only request these actions — they run after a second staff member with the same permission confirms. Nobody does them alone, not even an owner.
two_hands.none: The matrix has no two-person actions right now.

invite.title: Invite a staff member
invite.text: A second staff member with the permission confirms the invitation. After that a code goes to the work email; it lives 24 hours, and the second factor is set up at first sign-in.
invite.name: Name
invite.name_hint: Shown in the audit log and to other staff.
invite.cities_hint: A moderator needs at least one city.
invite.locale_hint: The invitation email and the interface use it; the staff member can change it later.

drawer.title: Staff member
drawer.not_found_text: They do not exist or the link is out of date.
drawer.comment_hint: Goes to the audit log. Required for “Other”.
drawer.journal: The action goes to the audit log.

resend.title: Invitation
resend.text: A new invitation code: the previous one stops working, and the 24-hour period starts again.
resend.done: A new invitation code was sent; the previous one no longer works.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.label: Staff member sessions
sessions.confirm_text: The staff member is signed out on every device and signs in again. The account stays active.
sessions.done: {count, plural, =0 {There were no active sessions} one {# session ended} other {# sessions ended}}

reset.title: Access reset
reset.text: When a staff member lost their password or phone. Takes two people.

consequences.secrets: Password, second factor and recovery codes stop working
consequences.sessions: All the staff member’s sessions end
consequences.invite: A new invitation is sent to the work email

disable.title: Disable account
disable.text: Removes the role: sign-in closes, sessions and pending requests are cancelled. History and the audit log stay.

consequences.role: The role is removed, sign-in is closed
consequences.sessions: All sessions and pending requests of the staff member are cancelled
consequences.history: History and the audit log are kept

platform.approval_failed: Request approved but not carried out

lootboxes.note: Loot boxes as a quest reward

gk_rotation.note: The goalkeeper changes during the match

cities.label: Cities
cities.empty_text: Activate the first city from the GeoNames directory.

activate.title: Activate city
activate.text: Find a place in the GeoNames directory, check the country and region and choose a status. The city appears in the apps once its country is enabled.
activate.prompt_text: Search matches the start of the name in Russian, English or Latin script.
activate.country_hint: Defaults to the place country. Only enabled countries are listed.
activate.region_hint: The GeoNames region is created automatically if it does not exist yet.
activate.region_hint_override: Country changed: the place region does not belong to it. Without a choice the city has no region.
activate.find_city: Find the city in the list

city.not_found_text: It is not in the directory or the address is outdated.

status.title: Status
status.label: City status
status.unknown_error: This admin version does not know the status — choose one from the list

slug.title: Web address
slug.label: Address (slug)
slug.hint: Lowercase Latin letters, digits, hyphens between parts, up to 100 characters. The old address keeps working.

names.title: Names
names.confirm_text: Apps in this language will show the name in the country language.
names.delete_hint: An empty name is not saved. To delete the translation, use “Delete translation”.

districts.title: Districts
districts.label: City districts
districts.empty_text: Districts help players find matches nearby.

link.title: Link to GeoNames
link.text: Find the city place in the GeoNames directory. Linking adds missing name translations; population and coordinates do not change.

glossary.dual_approval: The action runs only after a second staff member with the same permission approves it: one person cannot do it alone.
glossary.scoped: The permission applies only to the cities assigned to the staff member: a moderator sees and changes their own cities.
glossary.city_status: “Waitlist” — no games in the city yet, players are invited to become a captain; “pilot” and “live” — cities with games.
glossary.geonames: An open gazetteer of places worldwide: a city is created from its data — name, coordinates, population, time zone.
glossary.slug: The part of the city page link on the website: lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens only.
glossary.recovery_codes: One-time sign-in codes for when the authenticator app is not at hand: each works once.
glossary.feature_flag: A switch that turns a feature on everywhere or in selected cities without releasing a new app version.
